clips.title: The story
paras: Smoke still rises from the Ravaged Caravan on Stonebull Lake's northeastern shore in Mulgore. The Venture Company convoy was bound for Supervisor Fizsprocket's mining operation before tauren defenders destroyed it.

The ruined wagons sit on a rise above Stonebull Lake, where tauren from Bloodhoof Village stopped the Venture Company. The convoy carried mining supplies, blueprints, and equipment to Supervisor Fizsprocket's dig site, but tauren defenders wrecked it before it could arrive. Venture Co. survivors still cling to the wagons and smoldering crates, guarding what cargo remains.
